verdict.rationale: Zapier documents a Workflow API for powering built-in automation and AI workflows, and says embedding it lets customers build workflows inside a host app. That points to its own programmatic workflow creation. The MCP and SDK evidence covers running individual actions or stored actions, not creating or managing Zaps, so it does not count here. missing for 10: documented endpoints for creating, updating and activating (turning on) a workflow, any evidence that an agent can drive this lifecycle end to end, a published API spec (the OpenAPI probe returned 404), and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent create, update, and activate a workflow programmatically through the public API

citations.quote: Use Zapier's Workflow API and 9,000 integrations to power a built-in automation experience, integration marketplace, or AI workflows.
Bring Zapier’s automation into your own product so customers can build workflows and run actions without leaving your app.
